name: Manjula Asthana Mahanti

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Manjula Asthana Mahanti is a poet, author, editor and translator whose Kabita Live contributions include Hindi and English poetry. Her literary work follows a career in teaching and school leadership. In a 2019 interview she described Abhishap Damini Ka as her first published translation and discussed her ghazal collection Iztiraab, also listed in the AABS Publishing House catalogue.

Her poems connect reflection on the self with attention to the world around it. ‘Who are you!’ and ‘Observation’ turn towards identity and perception, while ‘ये कहाँ आ गए हम.....’ and ‘शहरीकरण ...’ question what is lost as relationships and places change. Rain offers another kind of return: in ‘स्मृति’ and ‘वर्षा’, wet earth, children and paper boats bring the present into conversation with childhood.
